brief: The canvas depicts an immensely vast, structured network of crystalline geodes, forming an organized grid across the plane. These geological formations appear to expand and shift continuously, simulating the monumental, slow creep of tectonic plates. The crystals are rendered in rich, varied mineral tones, emphasizing the interlocking complexity and inherent structural patterns. There is no user interaction required; the entire diagram moves organically and perpetually, conveying a sense of immense, ongoing geological time and pressure.
